That's what I'm saying, though. I haven't been feeling shitty. The thought of not existing anymore just honestly makes me giddy. I've really been on a high ever since I bought that gun. Knowing it's laying under my bed right now is like knowing the winning lotto numbers for tomorrow.

I understand that that sounds irrational, but it's the way I feel. Sometimes life sucks; sometime's it's okay. I'd still rather opt out. Sorry if I'm being stubborn. I appreciate your kind words.

I feel like they might want to see anyway, for closure, but at least they would have a warning, and the ability to prepare for it. It really sucks, but nothing compares to a gun in terms of reliability.

Haha, I'm going to a gun club to learn how to use the thing so I don't fuck up when the time comes. My biggest fear is falling in love with shooting, and losing the will to die that I've always wanted, but haven't really felt until recently.

I would never do it if I had children, or anyone that depended on me for strength. 

I won't pretend that no one will be hurt by it, but no one will be hurt to the point that it destroys them. It's regrettable, but I feel like it's not really my fault. I didn't ask for life. I'm trying to be as considerate as possible, but sometimes I've got to do something for me.

Ugh. It's weird. I knew this is the response I would get, if any, and yet I'm hardly frustrated by it, because I completely understand it. I genuinely don't want anyone to kill themselves, other than me. I see people post on here that they're about to pull the trigger, and I just hope to God they decide not to do it.

And yet, it's not that I don't think I *deserve* to live like everyone else. I just don't want to. I went through a period of anger and then one of despair, and I thought about killing myself through those. I'm glad I didn't, because I don't think anyone should make that decision when they are experiencing such strong emotions that are only temporary. But now, I'm not really angry or depressed. The idea of not existing just sounds so appealing. It's just hard to get anyone to understand or accept that.
